entities.name: Glasspool
entities.description: Huge, hexagonal lake on Akoum, the only notable fixed body of water there.

entities.name: Glass Haven
entities.description: Kor Haven on the shores of Glasspool.

entities.name: Ior
entities.description: Ruined sacred pilgrimage site at the bottom of Glasspool, over 6000 years old.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: Zendikari people who gathered around Glasspool and consider Ior sacred.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Their return prompted the kor to gather at Glasspool.

entities.name: Roil
entities.description: Seismic upheaval that fails to affect Glasspool.

events.summary: During the eldrazi's return, the kor gather around Glasspool, carving dwellings into the peaks and protecting the lake with webbing of hooks and ropes.
events.quote: kor gathered in the area around Glasspool

relations.quote: Glasspool is a lake on the continent of Akoum

relations.note: Ruin at the bottom of the lake.
relations.quote: Ior is a ruined site at the bottom of Glasspool
